Agent.description: An agent definition (Agent Platform). Fields are snake_case, matching the python-genai GAOS wire format.

base_environment.description: The environment configuration for the agent: either an inline remote-environment object or an environment ID.

description.description: Agent description for developers to quickly read and understand.

id.description: The unique identifier for the agent.

tools.description: The tools available to the agent.

AgentCodeExecutionTool.description: Enables code execution for an agent.

AgentFunctionTool.description: A function (callable tool) available to an agent.

parameters.description: JSON Schema for the function parameters, when the agent calls it with structured arguments.

AgentGoogleSearchTool.description: Enables Google Search grounding for an agent.

AgentMcpServerTool.description: An MCP server exposed to an agent as a tool.

headers.description: HTTP headers sent to the MCP server.

AgentTool.description: A tool available to an agent. Discriminated by its `type` field.

AgentUrlContextTool.description: Enables URL context grounding for an agent.

AntigravityAgentConfig.description: Configuration parameters for an Antigravity agent.

max_total_tokens.description: Maximum total tokens for the agent.

ApiSchema.description: Subset of the Gemini Schema object used for function and response schemas.

AuthToken.description: Ephemeral token that constrains BidiGenerateContent (Live API) sessions created with it.

name.description: Auth token name in the form `auth_tokens/{token}`. Pass it as the API key when connecting to BidiGenerateContent sessions.

uses.description: Remaining number of times the token can be used. Resuming a session does not count as a use.

BidiGenerateContentSetup.description: Locked BidiGenerateContent (Live API) session parameters applied to every session created with the token. Mirrors the Live API `setup` message.

model.description: ID of the model to configure for Live API sessions.

Blob.description: Inline bytes for image, audio, or video content.

Content.description: Contains the multi-part content of a message.

role.description: Producer of the content. Common values are `user` and `model`.

CreateAgentInteraction.description: Request to create an agent-backed interaction. Exactly one of this shape or `CreateModelInteraction` is the body of `POST /v1beta/interactions`.

agent.description: Agent option to run, e.g. `antigravity-preview-05-2026` or a Deep Research agent ID.

background.description: Run the interaction in the background.

stream.description: If true, the response is a server-sent event stream of interaction events instead of a single JSON object.

CreateAuthTokenRequest.description: Request for `auth_tokens.create`. Field names follow the python-genai SDK wire format.

fieldMask.description: Comma-separated list of Live API setup fields locked by the token. Absent means the whole setup is locked.

uses.description: Number of times the token can be used. Zero means no limit. Resuming a session does not count as a use. Defaults to 1.

from_environment.description: The source environment to copy/fork from. When specified, `sources` must be empty.

sources.description: Sources to be mounted into the environment.

CreateInteractionRequest.description: Body of `POST /v1beta/interactions`: either an agent-backed or a model-backed interaction.

CreateModelInteraction.description: Request to create a model-backed interaction. Exactly one of this shape or `CreateAgentInteraction` is the body of `POST /v1beta/interactions`.

background.description: Run the interaction in the background.

model.description: Model to run the interaction with.

stream.description: If true, the response is a server-sent event stream of interaction events instead of a single JSON object.

Credential.description: Server-managed credential resource stored in Secret Manager. Fields are snake_case, matching the python-genai GAOS wire format. Secret values are input-only and never returned.

id.description: Output only. Unique identifier for the credential.

status.description: Output only. Current status of the credential.

type.description: Output only. The type of credential.

CredentialUpdateRequest.description: Body of `PATCH /v1beta/credentials/{id}`, discriminated by `type`. Same shapes as the create variants with every field optional.

Environment.description: An execution environment for an agent (Agent Platform). Fields are snake_case, matching the python-genai GAOS wire format.

file_count.description: Output only. The number of files in the environment.

id.description: Output only. The ID of the environment.

size_bytes.description: Output only. Total size of the environment files in bytes.

status.description: Output only. The status of the environment container.

EnvironmentFile.description: Metadata for a file or directory within a Code Execution environment snapshot. Unlike the proto-JSON surfaces, this endpoint serializes fields in snake_case (matching the python-genai GAOS wire format).

mime_type.description: MIME type of the file. Empty for directories.

path.description: Full relative path within the environment, e.g. `workspace/src/main.py`.

size_bytes.description: Size of the file or directory in bytes.

EnvironmentNetworkEgressAllowlist.description: Egress allowlist for an environment's network.

EnvironmentSource.description: A source mounted into an execution environment.

source.description: Location of the source (e.g. GCS prefix).

injection_location.description: Locations where the value can be injected.

trusted_domains.description: Domains allowed to receive this environment variable.

value.description: Input only. Secret value of the environment variable. Write-only; never returned in responses.
Input only. Secret value of the environment variable.

downloadUri.description: Download URI for downloadable files, such as generated batch result files. The official Files guide says uploaded files cannot be downloaded.

source.description: Use `GENERATED` plus `downloadUri` or the guide-documented `/download/v1beta/...:download` route for downloadable batch result files. Uploaded files are not downloadable.

FileData.description: URI-based file reference used inside message parts.

GenerationConfig.description: Configuration options for model generation and outputs.

GenericJsonObject.description: Placeholder schema. This repo only promotes request and response shapes to concrete schemas when they are verified against a current machine-readable upstream source.

GetEnvironmentFilesResponse.description: Response for retrieving files from an environment snapshot. When the requested path is a directory this contains its contents; when it is a file this contains a single metadata entry. Fields are snake_case, matching the python-genai GAOS wire format.

GoogleDuration.description: Duration string ending in `s`, for example `3.5s`.

header_name.description: Header name to inject the token into.

prefix.description: Prefix prepended to the token. Defaults to `Bearer`.

token.description: Input only. The static bearer token. Write-only; never returned in responses.
Input only. The static bearer token.

Interaction.description: An Agent Platform interaction: a stateful execution of an agent or model with inputs, steps, and outputs. Fields are snake_case, matching the python-genai GAOS wire format.

agent.description: Agent option for agent-backed interactions, e.g. `antigravity-preview-05-2026` or a Deep Research agent ID.

cached_content.description: Cached content resource for model interactions.

errors.description: Output only. Errors produced by the interaction.

id.description: Output only. The ID of the interaction.

previous_interaction_id.description: ID of the interaction this one continues.

response_format.description: Structured output format for the interaction.

status.description: Output only. The status of the interaction.

steps.description: Output only. The interaction's execution steps.

InteractionContent.description: Typed content part of the interactions API. Discriminated by `type` (`text`, `image`, `audio`, `video`, `document`); this is an open union, so variant-specific fields beyond the common ones below are preserved as-is.

uri.description: URI of the payload when it is not inline.

InteractionEnvironment.description: Remote execution environment configuration for an agent or interaction.

env.description: Environment variables: a map of name to value/credential binding, or a serialized string.

environment_id.description: ID of an existing environment to reuse.

network.description: Network egress configuration for the environment.

code.description: A URI that identifies the error type.

InteractionGenerationConfig.description: Generation config for model-backed interactions. Covers the documented top-level fields; nested configs (image, speech, video, transcription) follow the interactions wire format.

InteractionModalityTokens.description: Token count for one response modality.

InteractionStep.description: A single execution step of an interaction. Discriminated by `type`; known step types include `user_input`, `thought`, `model_output`, `function_call`, `function_result`, `code_execution_call`, `code_execution_result`, `google_search_call`, `google_search_result`, `google_maps_call`, `google_maps_result`, `file_search_call`, `file_search_result`, `mcp_server_tool_call`, `mcp_server_tool_result`, `processing_call`, `processing_result`, `retrieval_call`, `retrieval_result`, `url_context_call`, and `url_context_result`. This is an open union, so step-specific fields are preserved as-is.

content.description: Content carried by the step, when applicable.

error.description: Error status attached to the step.

InteractionUsage.description: Statistics on the interaction request's token usage.

InteractionWebhookConfig.description: Webhook delivery configuration for an interaction.

uris.description: Webhook URIs that receive interaction events.

InteractionsInput.description: Input for an interaction: a prompt string, a single content object, a list of content objects, or a list of steps.

next_page_token.description: A token to retrieve the next page of results.

ListTriggerExecutionsResponse.description: Response for listing executions of a trigger.

metadata.description: Operation-specific metadata. Structure varies by endpoint.

response.description: Operation result. Structure varies by endpoint.

OAuth2CredentialConfig.description: OAuth2 credential with automatic token refresh (create).

client_secret.description: Input only. OAuth2 client secret. Write-only; never returned in responses.

refresh_token.description: Input only. OAuth2 refresh token. Write-only; never returned in responses.

token_url.description: OAuth2 token endpoint URL for refreshing access tokens.

OAuth2CredentialUpdate.description: OAuth2 credential with automatic token refresh (update).

Part.description: A single part of a multi-part message.

revocation_behavior.description: The revocation behavior for previous signing secrets.

Trigger.description: A trigger configuration that is scheduled to run an agent. Fields are snake_case, matching the python-genai GAOS wire format.

consecutive_failure_count.description: Output only. Consecutive failures since the last success.

environment_id.description: The environment ID for the trigger execution.

execution_timeout_seconds.description: The execution timeout for the triggered interaction.

id.description: Output only. The ID of the trigger.

max_consecutive_failures.description: Maximum consecutive failures allowed before the trigger is automatically paused.

previous_interaction_id.description: Output only. ID of the last interaction created by this trigger.

schedule.description: The cron schedule on which the trigger runs (standard cron format).

status.description: Output only. The current status of the trigger.

time_zone.description: Time zone in which the schedule is interpreted.

schedule.description: The cron schedule on which the trigger should run.

time_zone.description: Time zone in which the schedule should be interpreted.

TriggerExecution.description: An execution instance of a trigger.

environment_id.description: Output only. The environment ID used for the execution.

error.description: Output only. The error message if the execution failed.

id.description: Output only. The ID of the trigger execution.

interaction_id.description: Output only. The ID of the interaction created by this execution.

status.description: Output only. The status of the execution.

trigger_id.description: Output only. The ID of the trigger that created this execution.

Webhook.description: A webhook resource delivering event notifications. Fields are snake_case, matching the python-genai GAOS wire format.

id.description: Output only. The ID of the webhook.

name.description: The user-provided name of the webhook.

new_signing_secret.description: Output only. The new signing secret. Only populated on create and rotate responses.

signing_secrets.description: Output only. The signing secrets of the webhook.

state.description: Output only. The state of the webhook.

subscribed_events.description: The events that the webhook is subscribed to.

uri.description: The URI to which webhook events are sent.

name.description: The user-provided name of the webhook.

uri.description: The URI to which webhook events will be sent.

secret.description: Output only. The newly generated signing secret.

WebhookSigningSecret.description: A signing secret used to verify webhook payloads (truncated form; the full secret is only revealed once).

expire_time.description: Output only. The expiration date of the signing secret.

truncated_secret.description: Output only. The truncated version of the signing secret.
